goal: GAP SWEEP (wave 5b): every listed depth_target is currently not_simulated/config_only in the shipped console. Build each one on a REAL backend (Nano + offline) and lift its capability level to full or limited. 'Out of Vyomi's scope', 'separate product', 'single-account' or 'not modeled' are NOT acceptable reasons: model it in the shared core (Python core/*_core.py, vendored to wasm), wire it through the native wire, enforce behaviour (not stored config), and make the console section live. Only leave a target not_simulated if it needs something physically impossible in a local simulator (real external hardware, real money, a real third-party service) — and then write that concrete reason. config_only targets must become enforced (the setting changes observable behaviour). Update core/capabilities, tests/conformance, ui-spec mapping and smoke where relevant.
note: WAVE 5b gap sweep (orchestrator). Approved by the user: finish all the gaps with real backends.

depth_targets.title: "Open query" (Azure Resource Graph Explorer) on the Topics list
depth_targets.current_reason: Azure Resource Graph is a separate, cross-resource-type query service (its own Kusto-based engine spanning every resource in a subscription) and is not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Secondary toolbar actions on a topic's Activity log and Locks panels (Edit columns, Export, Insights, Feedback, pin/reset filters)
depth_targets.current_reason: Column customization, log export/insights and portal feedback are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Event subscriptions on a topic — create, list, get, update, delete (destination, filters)
depth_targets.current_reason: The appliance (offline substrate) does not yet implement the Microsoft.EventGrid/eventSubscriptions extension resource; only Nano and the dev server do.

depth_targets.title: Dead-lettering and retry policy (max delivery attempts, event TTL, expiration time)
depth_targets.current_reason: Expiration time IS enforced: an event subscription past its expirationTimeUtc is swept (auto-deleted, same as real Event Grid) before any GET/list sees it. Max delivery attempts and event time-to-live round-trip (PUT/GET) but are never enforced, because there is no delivery runtime to retry against — see azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.delivery.

depth_targets.title: Event delivery (filter matching, pushing to the destination endpoint, retries, dead-lettering)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi stores topics and event subscriptions and returns them over the native ARM wire, but there is no publish/delivery runtime: no event is ever matched against a subscription's filters, pushed to its destination, retried, or dead-lettered.

depth_targets.title: Alerts, metrics, diagnostic settings and logs on a topic
depth_targets.current_reason: Metrics charts, alert rules, diagnostic-setting log routing and Log Analytics queries are not modeled.
depth_targets.hint: telemetry: emit real metrics/logs from the simulated engine (wave-6 Prometheus/OTel are the offline sinks once landed; until then derive real series from actual API activity in the core) — never synthetic random data

depth_targets.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks, and Support + Troubleshooting
depth_targets.current_reason: These portal troubleshooting and support tools are not modeled.
